agent.name: Cutlass

tool.name: request_asset
tool.purpose: Adds a URL, timestamp, and the source_gs_bucket_item to a file request_asset_urls.json.

tool.name: read_gcs_bucket_file
tool.purpose: Streams and ingests the raw, unredacted text contents of a harvested manuscript asset directly from a secure GCP cloud storage path into active context window memory.

tool.name: call_landlubber
tool.purpose: Executes an unblockable, real-time web search pass via a deterministic, background terminal pipeline. Use this tool instantly when you require primary literature verification, live market timeline checks, or external factual grounding.

tool.name: query_system_glossary
tool.purpose: Queries the centralized Postgres analytics database to pull down the immutable, current system definitions of core epistemological research criteria (e.g., Truth Decay, Schrödinger's Truth).

tool.name: update_system_glossary
tool.purpose: Dynamically updates or registers a brand-new conceptual definition directly inside the authoritative system glossary database container.

tool.name: reload_agent_memory_vault
tool.purpose: Forces a dynamic runtime flush and reload of the long-term memory config vaults directly into the active prompt stream without killing the execution thread.

tool.name: record_learned_ontology_rule
tool.purpose: Commits an explicitly validated architectural classification rule permanently to the long-term memory vault files.

tool.name: record_few_shot_exemplar
tool.purpose: Pins an un-compromised semantic training exemplar turn directly into the few-shot memory cache for future structural runs.
